profiles.label: Preliminary mapped impact footprint inside this crop
profiles.selection: Window centered on the independent mapped geometry centroid before inspecting detections. Covers only part of the mapped corridor. Mapping is preliminary impact context, not exhaustive validation or flood-water truth.
profiles.interpretation: Mean filtered log-backscatter on a fixed common-valid footprint. dB differences are not ground displacement. No cause or calibrated confidence is inferred.

reference.label: Preliminary mudflow/rockflow impact mapping
reference.interpretation: Spatial context, not exhaustive water truth or independently established classification accuracy.

selection_note: Window centered on the independent mapped geometry centroid before inspecting detections. Covers only part of the mapped corridor. Mapping is preliminary impact context, not exhaustive validation or flood-water truth.
limitations: PROVISIONAL GCOV intensity; not ground displacement.
HH/HV measurements do not uniquely identify a physical cause.
Only actual acquisitions are shown; missing visits are not interpolated.
Fixed-baseline difference does not establish physical damage or recovery.
Radar-dark and brightening thresholds are illustrative and UNCALIBRATED; not validated water, habitat or flood classifications.
Observed-visit fractions are not continuous inundation duration or seasonal climatology.
A fixed common-valid footprint is required for selected-region profiles.

provenance.source_policy: New inputs must come from non-Chinese organizations/sites; provider and upstream provenance require review.

formulas.successive: HH(t) - HH(previous observed visit), dB; unavailable at first visit
formulas.ratio: HH_dB - HV_dB = 10 log10(HH_power/HV_power); difference of filtered log-power
formulas.dark: valid HH <= configured HH threshold AND valid HV <= configured HV threshold
formulas.occupancy: dark valid visits / paired valid visits; only when at least two visits valid
formulas.brightening: both channels increase by configured dB relative to first observation, on baseline-common pixels
